It is the admiral who will die for it.|The Flame, an anti-Imperial rebellion leader, explains his motive for seeking Admiral Ange's death on Nar Shaddaa to Imperial heroes|<ref name="TF" />}}
'''Jefand Ange''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Admiral/Legends|admiral]] who served the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. In [[3643 BBY]], he was stationed on [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]].<ref name="TF" />
